objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (19 November 2026) on CENSUS-READ-20261118-001's direction 1. On the 522 census stages where no two junctions share two distinctions, no table symmetry moves a junction (all checked) and the name-free reader R3n misreads, decide with a stated bound on the rival arrangements whether the exact table admits a second legal arrangement, separating what the table cannot hold (its symmetries, excluded here), what the allowed states cannot hold (same states, different junctions) and what was the reader's weakness. stop_rule: A second legal arrangement with the same table and no symmetry between them, or all 522 unique within the bound; referee hand-off; report.
title: Does the bond-distance table fix every census arrangement it has no symmetry for?
